#Module serviceworker

Service workers (src/page/service_worker.odin; native/js/runtime/web_sw.c): registrations kept by the browser, each with up to three versions (installing, waiting, active), each version a JavaScript worker hosted by a page of its own while it runs; requests intercepted by the loader for the pages it controls. Page side: register, ready, the registrations and their versions, update, unregister, navigation preload, the controller, messages. Worker side: the events the browser sends (install, activate, fetch, message, the answers to its requests) and what the worker does. ServiceWorkerRegistration_info and ServiceWorker_info answer in both realms (a service worker reads the last state the browser sent it).

Exposed to: Window, Worker. Source: api/serviceworker.widl.

#Types

#struct SwEventInfo

What the current event of a service worker's realm is (kind 0: none waits).

fieldtype
kindi321 install, 2 activate, 3 fetch, 4 message, 5 the answer to a request (ServiceWorkerGlobalScope_reply 10), 6 the registration changed (ServiceWorkerRegistration_info has its new state), 7 a navigation preload's response
idu64fetch / preload: the fetch's id; answer: the request's id
modei32fetch: the request's mode (fetch.Mode); answer: 0 done, else rejected (text 0: why); preload: the status (0: failed)
destinationi32fetch: the request's destination (fetch.Destination)
clientu64the client (a page's id), 0 for a navigation
flagsi32fetch: 1 when a navigation preload runs for it (FetchEvent.preloadResponse)

#Functions

#ServiceWorker_register

Promise ServiceWorker_register(string script, optional string scope, string update_via_cache, bool module) raises

navigator.serviceWorker.register(script, {scope, updateViaCache, type}): a promise of the registration's id, resolved once the script ran (an unchanged script: at once; TypeError when it failed). Security outside a secure context, for another origin or a scope outside what the script may control.

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: ServiceWorker_register :: proc(c: ^Call, script: string, scope: Maybe(string), update_via_cache: string, module: bool) -> (u64, Api_Error)

Promise ServiceWorker_ready()

#ServiceWorkerRegistration_unregisterId

bool ServiceWorkerRegistration_unregisterId(u64 id)

registration.unregister(): true when it was the origin's and is gone.

Host: ServiceWorkerRegistration_unregisterId :: proc(c: ^Call, id: u64) -> bool

#ServiceWorkerRegistration_updateId

Promise ServiceWorkerRegistration_updateId(u64 id) raises

registration.update(): a promise of the registration's id once its script was checked (a new version then installs). Invalid_State when the registration is gone.

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: ServiceWorkerRegistration_updateId :: proc(c: ^Call, id: u64) -> (u64, Api_Error)

#ServiceWorkerRegistration_preload

string ServiceWorkerRegistration_preload(u64 id, i32 op, string header) raises

registration.navigationPreload: op 0 getState, 1 enable, 2 disable, 3 setHeaderValue(header). The state after: enabled (1 / 0), "\n", the header value. Invalid_State for enable / disable without an active version.

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: ServiceWorkerRegistration_preload :: proc(c: ^Call, id: u64, op: i32, header: string) -> (string, Api_Error)

#ServiceWorker_postToWorker

void ServiceWorker_postToWorker(u64 version, bytes data) raises

serviceWorker.postMessage(message): the serialized message to that version's worker (started if it stopped).

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: ServiceWorker_postToWorker :: proc(c: ^Call, version: u64, data: []u8) -> Api_Error

#ServiceWorker_takeMessage

bytes ServiceWorker_takeMessage() raises

The next message a service worker sent this page (Not_Found when none waits): the sender's version id (8 bytes) then the serialized message.

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: ServiceWorker_takeMessage :: proc(c: ^Call) -> ([]u8, Api_Error)

#ServiceWorkerGlobalScope_reply

void ServiceWorkerGlobalScope_reply(i32 kind, u64 id, i64 code, string headers, string text, bytes body)

What the worker did: 1 install done (code 1 ok, 0 failed), 2 activate done, 3 respond (code = status, headers, text = the response's URL, body), 4 fall back to the network, 5 fail (text: why), 6 skipWaiting, 7 clients.claim, 8 a message to a client (code = the client's id, 0 every controlled page; body = the serialized message), 10 a request answered later by an event 5 (id = the request's id, code = 1 clients.matchAll (headers: "includeUncontrolled TAB type"), 2 clients.get (text: id), 3 clients.openWindow (text: URL), 4 navigate (text: URL, headers: the client's id), 5 focus (text: the client's id), 6 registration.update, 7 registration.unregister), 11 navigation preload (code = op as ServiceWorkerRegistration_preload, text = the header value).

Host: ServiceWorkerGlobalScope_reply :: proc(c: ^Call, kind: i32, id: u64, code: i64, headers: string, text: string, body: []u8)
